Sportclub Telstar, commonly known simply as Telstar, is a Dutch professional football club based in IJmuiden, North Holland. Nicknamed the Witte Leeuwen (\"White Lions\") for their all‑white home strip, the team competes in the Eredivisie, the highest tier of the Dutch football league system, having secured promotion via the 2024–25 play‑offs—their first top‑flight appearance since 1978.
